decisions.reason: Black-finish variants extend the core range cheaply and follow an ongoing bathroom design trend, so the firm will keep them.
A shower channel for seamless coverings supports the barrier-free bathroom strategy and is actively promoted on its own page.
The tileable floor drain is a standard product close to the core expertise and costs little to keep in the range.
The stainless steel design grate fits the design-led positioning and the firm's own manufacturing, so keeping it carries little risk.
The pump-drain shower channel replaces the withdrawn pump solution and has its own page, so it gets time to prove itself, although pump products carry higher risk.
